opportunities.title: NOC Oman — Agency / commission agreement (شركة نوك العمانية)
opportunities.scope: Agency agreement covering O&M contracts and technical support contracts. Commission article under negotiation.
opportunities.lastFollowUpText:
شركة نوك العمانية تعترض على النسب وانهم يريدون نسبة من كل العقد.

NOC's counter-position (per email reply to Aly Ahmed Aly):
1) O&M Contracts — EPROM position: 2% on the O&M management fees only, not total contract value (total may include equipment, spare parts and other pass-through costs with no margin for EPROM). NOC proposes 2.5% for O&M contracts, plus any profitable scope of work; the proposed profitable-items list to be attached to the agreement as Appendix (1) to avoid conflict or misunderstanding.
2) Technical Support Contracts — EPROM position: 1.5% on the project management fees. NOC proposes 2%.
3) Payment Terms — no advance payment; commission payable only after EPROM has actually received the corresponding invoiced amounts from the client. AGREED (OK).
4) For any contract not falling under points 1 & 2, the commission is to be fixed in advance but not less than the above.

Action: amend the commission article in the agreement accordingly and add clauses covering any executed services not already covered, to prevent future conflicts.
